description:
List members in a Discord server.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - limit (number): Maximum number of members (1-100, default: 20)
  - after (string, optional): Pass the highest user ID from the previous page
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  List of members with username, nickname, roles, join date

after.description: Get members after this user ID (for pagination)

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_list_members
title: List Discord Members
